context.content: I have a few questions about the movie "The Grand Budapest Hotel" (2014). Can you tell me who directed it and what the movie is about? Also, do you know if there's a sequel or any other movies in the same genre? Thank you!

I'm into romance movies, but I also enjoy films that are visually appealing and have a unique storytelling style. Something that balances romance with a bit of humor and maybe even some mystery would be perfect. [END]
